project_type: AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript) infra + dependency-light vanilla JS/HTML/CSS SPA. Standalone demo under a larger repo.
build_system: npm + CDK v2 monolithic aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0. TypeScript ~5.5.4 via ts-node. No bundler/build step for the SPA (static files shipped verbatim via s3-deployment BucketDeployment).
test_framework: Custom tiny assert harness in infra/test/template.test.ts run through ts-node (NOT jest). Uses aws-cdk-lib/assertions Template.fromStack + Match. Exits non-zero on any failed check.
verification_instructions: From infra/: (1) npx tsc --noEmit for type check; (2) npm test for template assertions (prints 'ok' per check, exits 0); (3) CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 npx cdk synth --all for synth. For the SPA, serve statically (python3 -m http.server from spa/) and verify behavior in a browser; no build step. Deploy only via the explicit cdk deploy command for SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in from build/test. (deploy.sh regenerates diagram/architecture.png but that is out of scope and must not be touched.)
environment_constraints: Region pinned ap-southeast-1 everywhere EXCEPT the CloudFront ACM cert which lives in us-east-1 (CloudFront requirement). Account 875692608981. VPC is imported, never created. The ACM cert and Route53 hosted zone already exist and MUST be reused as-is (do not create a new cert or zone). Deploy touches live, billable infra and is authorized; do NOT run destroy. Set CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 and the AWS_REGION/CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1 env vars for synth/deploy.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. README mandates: region pinned ap-southeast-1, VPC imported, keep the SPA dependency-light (no framework, no build step). Do NOT modify security-data-stack.ts, Lambda (app/) code, Bedrock/Guardrail config, or deploy.sh/destroy.sh unless strictly necessary (justify in findings if so).
key_patterns: Cross-region ACM: use acm.Certificate.fromCertificateArn with a plain ARN string (an unresolved import, no lookup, no crossRegionReferences flag needed) — NOT DnsValidatedCertificate, NOT a new cert. Importing (not creating) the cert means NO AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate resource is synthesized, so the existing test asserting that count == 0 still passes. Route53: route53.HostedZone.fromHostedZoneAttributes + route53.ARecord/AaaaRecord with RecordTarget.fromAlias(new targets.CloudFrontTarget(distribution)), recordName 'cafe-nova' under zone aws.yikyakyuk.com. All these modules are part of the monolithic aws-cdk-lib v2 (no new dependency). SPA: messages live only in the DOM under <section id='log' class='log'>; there is NO localStorage/sessionStorage and NO separate in-memory array (grep-confirmed), and NO 'assistant is typing' indicator exists. The pending-refund box is a child of #log, so emptying #log removes it. app.js owns `const log = getElementById('log')`; ui.js/diagram.js deliberately never touch #log/#chatForm, so clear logic belongs in app.js. Chat header is .chat-panel-header with #chatPanelTitle + #closeChat (styled .chat-close, hover rgba(247,239,230,0.15)).
